Real sharks have dermal denticles; even if blurred by water, some texture variance should exist. The image also exhibits significant noise/grain (confirmed by perceptual auditor) and motion blur, which, while potentially photographic, often mask AI structural errors in the tail region. The clean topology mask suggests no gross melting, but the lack of surface detail lowers the artifact score significantly compared to a high-fidelity reference.
